"scripts": {
    "check": "npm run globals:check && npm run structure:check && tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run format:check",
    "globals:check": "node --import ./scripts/typescript-resolve.mjs scripts/generate-global-contract.ts --check",
    "globals:generate": "node --import ./scripts/typescript-resolve.mjs scripts/generate-global-contract.ts",
    "structure:check": "node scripts/check-structure.mjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "lint": "oxlint --deny-warnings .",
    "lint:fix": "oxlint --fix --deny-warnings .",
    "format": "oxfmt --write .",
    "format:check": "oxfmt --check .",
    "quality:audit": "node scripts/audit-code-size.mjs",
    "package:check": "node scripts/verify-package.mjs"
  },
  "pi": {
    "extensions": [
      "./src/index.ts"
    ],
    "durable": "./src/durable/index.ts",
    "prompts": [
      "./prompts"
    ]
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-codemode": "1.5.0",
    "oxfmt": "0.77.0",
